proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING CHANGE IN STOCKHOLDER VOTING
proposals.topic_summary: Requests the board pursue a recapitalization plan giving one vote per share for all outstanding stock, including negotiating with Class B holders to relinquish disproportionate voting rights.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING A LOBBYING REPORT
proposals.topic_summary: Requests an annually updated report disclosing direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, trade association memberships, and board oversight of such payments.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING FALSE NEWS
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report reviewing public policy issues associated with fake news enabled by Facebook, including impacts on democracy, free speech, and reputational and operational risks.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING A GENDER PAY EQUITY REPORT
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report on Facebook's policies and goals to reduce the gender pay gap, including pay gap percentages and reduction targets.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.

proposals.title: STOCKHOLDER PROPOSAL REGARDING AN INDEPENDENT CHAIR
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy and bylaw amendment requiring the Board Chair to be an independent director, applied prospectively, with a waiver if no independent director is available.
proposals.evidence: The board of directors recommends a vote AGAINST the stockholder proposal.
